name: axion-search
description: AXION Search 4.2 — Cloudflare Pages + Workers, live Google AI Studio Gemma 4 rotation, IndexedDB history, 10ms CPU target.

scripts.dev:api: cd workers && npx wrangler dev --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.dev:pages: cd pages && npx wrangler pages dev ./public --config wrangler.jsonc --service AXION_SEARCH_API=axion-search-api
scripts.deploy:api: cd workers && npx wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:pages: cd pages && npx wrangler pages deploy ./public --project-name axion-search-site --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.test: node --check workers/src/index.js && node --check workers/src/search-engine.js && node --check "pages/functions/api/[[path]].js" && node --check pages/functions/health.js && node --check "pages/functions/s/[[path]].js" && node --check pages/public/js/app.js && node --check pages/public/js/home.js && node --check pages/public/js/search.js && node --check pages/public/js/settings.js && node --check pages/public/sdk/axion-search-sdk.js && node tests/smoke-tests.js
